added.summary: Paints a model's base colour from concept images (front, back, left, right, top, three_quarter or a camera, framed as og model preview frames them): each texel takes the view that sees it most squarely, a texel no view sees takes the nearest painted colour on the model, and the report gives each material's coverage. Writes <name>.<material>.basecolor.png beside the model, and the program's <name>.ogt or the mesh file with the maps.
